question.text: The incorrect statement regarding the reaction given below is

options.text: The product ‘<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math>’ formed in the above reaction is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math>-nitroso compound at low temperature
The reaction occurs at low temperature
The electrophile involved in the reaction is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>NO</mi><mo>+</mo></msup></math>

solution.text:
Nitrous acid is produce when sodium nitrate is reacted with acid. The nitrous acid can produce nitrosonium ion as electrophile. The tertiary amine given undergoes electrophilic substitution reaction with electrophile. The para substituted product is formed as major product.

NaNO2+HX→HNO2+NaX

2HNO2→NO++NO2-+H2O

∴ Statement 2 is incorrect
